subject: MAP workback: SDK + streaming + tool-calls — owners, handoffs, target close
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@healthsync.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP workback: SDK + streaming + tool-calls — owners, handoffs, target close

Tom — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed MAP workback focused on the integration milestones we discussed (SDK integration, streaming config, tool-calling hooks, structured outputs). Pulling this into a short set of owners and next steps so we can get to a shared target close.

High-level proposed milestones (suggested target dates):
- SDK integration: install, auth, basic generate/embeddings calls — owner: Dev — target: 2026-04-23
- Streaming endpoint: client integration + reconnect handling — owner: Dev — target: 2026-05-01
- Tool-calling surfaces: external API wiring + safety hooks — owner: Marissa — target: 2026-05-04
- Structured outputs: schema design + eval set — owner: Marissa & HealthSync Eng — target: 2026-05-06
- Production cutover readiness (QA, perf, fallback policies) — owner: Hannah/solutions — target: 2026-05-12

Dependencies we flagged on the call: access to HealthSync staging cluster (VPN credentials), sample payloads for tool-calls, and SOC2 evidence for audit. I attached an initial integration matrix and a one-page MAP draft for your team to review.

Ask: can you confirm owners on your side for the tooling/schema items and whether the proposed targets look good? If you want, Dev and Marissa can run a 30-min technical sync with your engineers this week.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_sdk_integration_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), map_draft_HealthSync_v1.pdf (summary)

From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@healthsync.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP workback: SDK + streaming + tool-calls — owners, handoffs, target close

Hi Hannah — thanks, that looks reasonable. Appreciate the level of detail. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We can own the schema review and test dataset generation (Priya will lead).
- For the tool-calls: we have a small internal service (svc-actions) that will need the webhook contract; would prefer to ship that in parallel with streaming so we can iterate on end-to-end behavior.
- VPN/staging access: I requested credentials from infra; ETA is 2 business days.

Two asks:
1) Can Dev and Marissa join a quick tech sync Wed or Thu? Priya and I are free Thu 11–12 PT.
2) Can you share the minimal set of logs/audit fields we need to capture for SOC2 check? Our security team will want that up front.

If we can hit the SDK target you suggested and get streaming integrated in the following sprint, I think the May 12 production-readiness target is achievable. We may try to move target close up if the security checks are light.

—Tom
Tom Evans
Head of Platform Engineering | HealthSync
tom.evans@healthsync.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP workback: SDK + streaming + tool-calls — owners, handoffs, target close

Tom / Hannah — looping in a succinct owner breakdown and the engineering-level dependencies we need to track.

Owner breakdown / tech notes:
- SDK integration (Dev) — deliverables: client install guide, auth examples (API key + OAuth where required), quickstart repo. Dev will provide a postman collection and example snippets for Node/Python.
- Streaming (Dev) — deliverables: ws client example, reconnect/backoff guidance, KV cache hints for long conversations. We'll instrument latency buckets for early perf checks.
- Tool-calling (Marissa) — deliverables: webhook contract doc, sample service adapter, safety curtain (output sanitizer). Need list of external endpoints and expected throughput (rps).
- Structured outputs (Marissa + HealthSync) — schema doc, evaluator harness, 50 example prompts with expected JSON. Suggest health-checks in CI for schema drift.

Key dependencies: staging creds, sample payloads, expected QPS, SLA on failure handling (sync vs async tool calls). If HealthSync expects sub-200ms median tail for chat streaming we should budget extra time for perf tuning.

I attached a quick spreadsheet with suggested owner tasks and an initial buildback schedule. Dev — can you confirm the dates above? Also adding a note: we should include a canary plan that falls back to a smaller model variant in case of early perf regressions.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0166

Attachment: redwood_sdk_integration_matrix.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@healthsync.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP workback: SDK + streaming + tool-calls — owners, handoffs, target close

Tom / Priya — confirmed for Thu 11am PT for the tech sync (we'll send a calendar invite). Quick notes and a tighter buildback I pushed into the spreadsheet:

Proposed technical sprint commitments
- Sprint A (Apr 19–25): SDK + basic auth + sample calls — owner: Dev — deliverable: quickstart repo, Postman collection
- Sprint B (Apr 26–May 2): Streaming client + reconnects + perf hooks — owner: Dev — deliverable: streaming client + perf report
- Sprint C (May 3–May 9): Tool-call wiring + safety adapter + schema v1 — owner: Marissa + HealthSync — deliverable: webhook adapter + schema tests
- Sprint D (May 10–May 12): Canary + QA + runbook — owner: Hannah/Dev — deliverable: canary runbook, rollback plan

Security/logging: minimal audit fields we need: request_id, user_id (hashed), timestamp, model_id, prompt_hash, response_length, tool_call_events (name, status), and retention window. I'll post a one-pager with the log schema to the Drive link Hannah shared.

Snippets: sample streaming client code in Node (for demo) — will drop in quickstart repo.

On the calendar invite: I'll include a short agenda: 1) VPN/staging access check, 2) webhook contract, 3) streaming reconnect policy, 4) finalizing target close.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

All — confirmed Thu 11am PT. Priya will join and bring the schema examples. A couple quick confirmations before the sync:

- We accept the sprint cadence you proposed. If SOC2 evidence is straightforward (request listed above), we may pull target close forward a week — aiming for May 5 instead of May 12.
- For tool-calls, expected initial throughput is ~15 rps peak, burst to 50 for 30s. Please confirm that the webhook adapter has simple retry semantics (3 retries, exponential backoff).

Thanks — looking forward to the sync. Can you send the calendar invite and the tech one-pager you mentioned?

Best,
Tom
Head of Platform Engineering | HealthSync
